sources.scope: MX only; 100 country-tagged surnames, snapshot of Wikipedia published surname tables (July 2023)
sources.use: Preserved ranked family-name spellings and Latin diacritics; entries selected before secondary source
sources.license_note: Repository describes dataset as CC0; upstream table provenance requires independent review

sources.scope: MX only; directory-derived surname-labelled entries, locatefamily.com snapshot (July 2019)
sources.use: Additional source-observed entries; numeric percentages deliberately discarded; require occurrence in at least one other batch-D country and exclude known first names, entity labels and invalid entries
sources.limitations: Noisy non-official directory extraction and ASCII-only spellings; where this source lacks diacritics they have not been conjecturally restored. Individual surname identity/licensing audit remains necessary before release

sources.scope: MX — surnames recorded as first or second family names in 1,256,438 federalized Secretaria de Educacion Publica workers, 2012; not a population census
sources.method: One surname field at a time, never concatenating two personal surnames; observed combined occurrences >=10; prioritize forms also appearing in ARG or CHI surname records. Uppercase source converted to titlecase; no invented diacritics or frequency weights.
sources.license_note: Data are derived from open SEP staff records; downstream redistribution terms and representativeness require review
